description: Header file defining classes, structs, and functions for navigation mesh generation in the Unvanquished game, including geometry processing, threading, and task management.

classes.name: Geometry
classes.description: Handles geometry data, including vertices, triangle mesh, and bounding box calculations.

classes.name: UnvContext
classes.description: Custom context class extending rcContext for logging and main thread task execution.

classes.name: NavgenStatus
classes.description: Represents the status of navigation mesh generation with status codes and messages.

classes.name: NavgenTask
classes.description: Encapsulates data and state for a navigation mesh generation task, including configuration, status, and processing context.

classes.name: NavmeshGenerator
classes.description: Main class managing the process of generating navigation meshes, including threading, task queue, and map loading.

methods.name: doLog
methods.description: Overrides rcContext's doLog to handle logging messages.

methods.name: RunOnMainThread
methods.description: Schedules a function to run on the main thread.

methods.name: DoMainThreadTasks
methods.description: Executes all scheduled main thread tasks.

methods.name: StartGeneration
methods.description: Begins a new navigation mesh generation task for a given species.

methods.name: LoadMapAndEnqueueTasks
methods.description: Loads map data and enqueues tasks for navigation mesh generation.

methods.name: FractionComplete
methods.description: Returns the fraction of the overall task that has been completed.

methods.name: StartBackgroundThreads
methods.description: Starts background threads for parallel navmesh generation.

methods.name: WaitInMainThread
methods.description: Waits for background processing to complete, optionally reporting progress.

methods.name: ThreadsDone
methods.description: Checks if all background threads have finished.

methods.name: PopTask
methods.description: Retrieves a task from the queue, requiring mutex lock if used concurrently.

methods.name: Step
methods.description: Performs a step of processing on a given task.

methods.name: BackgroundThreadMain
methods.description: Main function for background thread processing.
